result.quote: I found that the accusation involved questions about their own law
result.reason: The key is supported, but the question asks broadly what the captain said in the letter. Other defensible answers include that he rescued the man, learned he was a Roman citizen, brought him before the Sanhedrin, and found no charge worthy of death or imprisonment. The wording also needs articles, such as “What did the captain say in his letter to Felix?”—but even then it remains too broad for a unique answer.
